provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: In a controlled small composition neighborhood x in[0.04,0.06] at fixed T,P, V_m(x)=x*V_A+(1-x)*V_B+b*x*(1-x). The local function is stipulated, not fitted or extrapolated to all compositions. Partial molar volumes are d(n_total*V_m)/dn_i holding the other amount,T,P fixed: Vbar_A=V_m+(1-x)*dV_m/dx and Vbar_B=V_m-x*dV_m/dx.
target: Evaluate the local bulk volume and both partial molar volumes, check Euler identity x*Vbar_A+(1-x)*Vbar_B=V_m and interpret the sign. A partial derivative can be negative even with positive total volume; it is not a standalone component geometric volume.
scope: Local thermodynamic derivative model only, not a globally stable phase diagram or real measured mixture.
